description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Orianna''' commands ''[[File:Orianna Clockwork Windup.png|20xpx|border|link=Orianna#Clockwork Windup|An icon for Orianna's ability Clockwork Windup]] [[Orianna#Clockwork Windup|The Ball]]'' to emit an electric pulse that deals magic damage to nearby enemies.
description.text: Active: Orianna commands The Ball to emit an electric pulse that deals magic damage to nearby enemies.

description2.raw: The pulse leaves behind an electric field that last 3 seconds, granting [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] '''bonus''' movement speed to '''Orianna''' and her allies when they move within. Enemies that move within the field are [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] by the same amount, decaying over 2 seconds after leaving.
description2.text: The pulse leaves behind an electric field that last 3 seconds, granting  bonus movement speed to Orianna and her allies when they move within. Enemies that move within the field are slowed by the same amount, decaying over 2 seconds after leaving.
